# 1.20 General Investigational Plan - POC Draft

Case: IND006

## Rationale for the drug and the research
GF-088 is a subcutaneously administered biologic intended for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis in participants inadequately controlled on topical therapy.

## Indication to be studied
moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis

## General approach to evaluating the drug
A first-in-human study in healthy adults will establish safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics before evaluation in participants with atopic dermatitis.

## Kinds of clinical trials planned for the first year
One Phase 1 study in healthy adult participants is planned in the first year following submission.

## Estimated number of participants
Approximately 40 healthy adult participants.

## Anticipated risks of particular severity or seriousness
_Not supplied._
